name: W Hotel Barcelona
description: W Barcelona is a magnificent choice for travellers visiting Barcelona, offering a luxury atmosphere alongside numerous amenities designed to enhance your stay. Rooms include a flat-screen TV, minibar and air conditioning, and guests can stay connected with free wifi. A rooftop terrace, concierge and room service are among the services on offer, and the pool and breakfast will make your stay even more special.
address: Placa Rosa Del Vents, 1 Final Pg. de Joan de Borbó, 08039 Barcelona Spain

roomTips.text: Make sure to get the view facing the beach.
Book a cabana experience - and a high floor - you will not regret it!
Avoid rooms on first 6 floors. Close to the airport.
Plan to wait past check in time.

aiReviewSummary.title: What guests loved
aiReviewSummary.text: Guests consistently praise the iconic sail-shaped building, the beachfront location and the rooftop bar. Some recent reviews mention renovation noise and inconsistent room temperature.
